storiesPage.title: The Power of Stories
storiesPage.description: Stories have been humanity's oldest tool for remembering. They weave facts into emotions, making memories stick like nothing else can.

howStoriesHelp.title: How Stories Help Us Remember
howStoriesHelp.emotionDesc: Stories trigger feelings, which are powerful memory anchors.
howStoriesHelp.structureDesc: A beginning, middle, and end give our brain a framework to hang information on.
howStoriesHelp.visualDesc: Descriptive language creates vivid mental pictures we can recall easily.
howStoriesHelp.connectionDesc: We remember stories that reflect our own experiences or aspirations.

storiesPage.builtWithPassion: Built with passion for India's heritage. Storytelling that stays with you, long after you've left the place.

aboutPage.tagline: Where history whispers and stories come alive
aboutPage.creatorDesc1: Built with passion and devotion during
aboutPage.creatorDesc2: Reverie is more than just a travel companion—it's a bridge between generations, connecting the past with the present through the magic of storytelling and technology.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Reverie brings India's heritage alive through immersive, cinematic storytelling. We believe every temple, every ruin, and every city has a soul waiting to be discovered—not just visited.
aboutPage.specialDesc: We don't just give you facts—we weave together history, mythology, and human emotion into captivating narratives that transport you through time.
aboutPage.collabDesc: Are you a local guide, historian, storyteller, or heritage enthusiast? We'd love to collaborate with you! Help us uncover more hidden stories, create richer experiences, and make Reverie the most authentic cultural companion for travelers exploring India.
aboutPage.localGuidesDesc: Share your on-the-ground knowledge and insider stories
aboutPage.historiansScholarsDesc: Help us ensure historical accuracy and deep cultural context
aboutPage.storytellersArtistsDesc: Bring the magic of India's stories to life in new ways
